questions.question: Five men or ten women can complete a job in 20 days. In how many days can 3 men and 4 women complete it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 men can complete a job in 20 days

10 women can complete a job in 20 days

**Formula used:**

If two person can complete the work individually in x and y days then together they can complete the work in xy/(x + y) days

**Calculation:**

As, 5 men can complete a work in 20 days

⇒ 1 man can complete the work in 5 × 20 = 100 days

⇒ 3 men complete the work in (100/3) days

As, 10 women can complete the work in 20 days

⇒ 1 woman can complete the work in 10 × 20 = 200 days

⇒ 4 women complete the work in 200/4 = 50 days

Together 3 men and 4 women can complete the work in [(100/3) × 20]/(100/3 + 50) = (5000/3)/(250/3) = 20 days

**∴ 3 men and 4 women can complete the work in 20 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Five men or ten women can complete a job in 20 days,

5m = 10w

⇒ m = 2w (This means men are twice as efficient as compared to women)

Let the total work be 5 × 20 = 100 units

⇒ 3 men and 4 women = 3m + 4 × (m/2) = 5m

⇒ 3 men and 4 women can complete work in 100/5 = 20 days

∴ 3 men and 4 women can complete the work in 20 days
